record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The six units in appliesTo declare TELEPORT in this production reference. Passives of Mew (SYNCHRO), Cosmog (COSMOG) and Cosmoem (COSMOEM) are not investigated here.
record.summary: Relocates the caster to a free cell chosen by Board.getFlyAwayCell and, if a cell was found, marks the caster with TELEPORT_NEXT_ATTACK; its next attack then deals extra special damage (15/30/60/120 raw by stars) and clears the mark. The cast itself deals no damage. While the mark is set, the caster cannot cast again.

targeting.who: none at cast time (requiresTarget false: castable without walking up to a target). The destination cell is chosen by getFlyAwayCell from enemies/cells on the board.
targeting.note: getFlyAwayCell: returns null if no living enemy exists. Otherwise from unoccupied cells it keeps those strictly beyond the caster's own range from its current cell, and of those only cells within the caster's range of at least one targettable enemy; among them it keeps the lowest 'enemy threat count' (living enemies whose own range reaches the cell), then the highest distanceM from the caster's current position, then picks one at random. If no cell qualifies it falls back to getSafePlaceAwayFrom (origin = the caster's current target position or its own position, max distance = its range) plus the closest enemy; if that fails it returns null and the caster neither moves nor gets the mark. The random pick makes the destination non-deterministic. distanceC/distanceM metrics and getSafePlaceAwayFrom internals were not read.

geometry.shape: caster relocation to one free cell (swapCells); no area effect

effects.scaling: added to the caster's next attack as specialDamage: raw x (1 + AP/100), rounded up; times 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor only if the caster has ABILITY_CRIT and that attack crit. The array has no fallback for stars above 4 (unit-star index only).
effects.resolution: enters the attack's special damage, so later target-side processing (SPE_DEF, shields, protect/skydiving blocking, dodge) was not traced here. Applies only if a cell was found and the unit then makes an attack.

starBehavior.note: damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars at the time of the attack ([15,30,60,120][stars-1]); the cast does not scale with stars otherwise. maxPP is 50 for Abra/Kadabra/Alakazam/Mew and 100 for Cosmog/Cosmoem.

record.positionalConditions: Needs a living enemy for any destination; a free cell beyond the caster's range that lies within its range of a targettable enemy (preferred), else the getSafePlaceAwayFrom fallback; with no cell the cast does nothing visible beyond spending PP and no mark is set.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: The mark is a set member (not stacked). canCast is false while the mark is set, so a second cast cannot happen before the marked attack. No modes. Each cast re-runs the destination search.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 15/30/60 (1/2/3 stars) special damage on the next attack. Dealt amount = ceil(raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]) before target-side modifiers that were not traced.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage of the bonus after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, SPE_DEF, reduction effects) - only the added special damage amount was read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Whether the next attack succeeds (dodge, protect/skydiving block basic attacks; whether the bonus is still dealt then was not traced)
distanceC / distanceM metrics, isTargettableBy semantics and getSafePlaceAwayFrom internals
unresolved: Passives of Mew (SYNCHRO), Cosmog (COSMOG) and Cosmoem (COSMOEM) are not investigated: they may alter the cast or stats
The bonus is added inside PokemonState.attack's branch for successful-or-not attacks; whether the line sits in a block skipped when the attack misses/is blocked was not traced past the lines cited
Destination is chosen at random among tied cells, so no deterministic cell can be stated
